title: Amingaon
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Amingaon is a town on the north bank of the Brahmaputra, across the river from Guwahati, and the headquarters of Kamrup district.

Places

Amingaon is known for IIT Guwahati, which is located here, and for its ferry and bridge links to Guwahati city across the Brahmaputra.
